newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel prices narrowly mixed on slow day.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel prices narrowly mixed on slow day.

text.p: NEW YORK, May 5 (Reuter) U.S. spot jet fuel prices were narrowly mixed Monday afternoon, with New York Harbor differentials talked a bit lower and Gulf Coast values edging higher in exceedingly light trade, players said.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet fuel was offered at about 2.75 cents above June heating oil futures prices, about 0.25 cent weaker than Friday diffs.
But diffs firmed a half cent on Gulf Coast 54-grade, with a parcel sold for 0.75 cent below the screen, traders said.
"It was a very lackluster day. We're waiting for sellers to appear," a Gulf trader said, with few other deals seen.
NYMEX June heating oil futures, meanwhile, eked out a 0.03 cent gain to settle at 53.05 cents a gallon.
